description: This file defines a React component called RecommendationGrid that displays a grid of role recommendations based on user persona and filters. It includes functions for filtering roles, fetching data from APIs, and rendering role cards with expand/collapse behavior. The component supports loading and error states, filtering, and toggling between showing a subset or all recommendations.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined inputs.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a sanitized array of lowercase strings, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses a salary range from role data, attempting to extract numerical min and max values for filtering.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a role object, normalizing its string representation.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines whether a role object matches the specified filters: industry, skills, salary, and title.
